title: Account Executive, Crypto/Stablecoins
description:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 Stripe is dedicated to establishing a Product Sales team for Crypto/Stablecoins, aimed at empowering businesses to transform through our innovative platform.
 Our global Product Sales team spearheads Stripe’s revenue and growth initiatives. As key business allies, we excel in guiding users to comprehend and seamlessly integrate Stripe products, enabling them to focus on their core business objectives. Known for our product expertise, analytical thinking, and user-centered problem-solving, we serve as a vital channel for user feedback and market insights, significantly impacting Stripe’s product direction and growth strategies.
 What you’ll do
 As an Account Executive for Crypto/Stablecoins, you will leverage your sales and product expertise to drive the growth of Stripe’s stablecoin solutions across various customer segments. Collaborating with product, engineering, marketing, and other GTM teams, you will cultivate profound product and industry knowledge to manage complex deals. Your role will be crucial in leading in-depth product discussions with existing and prospective customers, shaping and implementing our market strategy.
 You are a skilled sales professional, comfortable with business-level and technical dialogues across diverse organizational tiers. You excel in competitive scenarios, passionately working on products demanding deep understanding and technical acumen. You thrive in client interactions as well as collaborati…

title: Technical Account Specialist - Storm, Sewer, Flood
description:
Job Requisition ID #
 26WD99973
 Position Overview
 We are seeking an expert in InfoWorks ICM (ICM) to assist our customers in adopting and optimizing their software. This is not a traditional software support role, instead you will engage new and existing customers to ensure they are using ICM as efficiently and effectively as possible, from both an IT and engineering perspective. You will use your in-depth experience to enable, support and guide our customers throughout their water projects.
 This is a proactive role where you will develop a strategy to understand which customers we should speak to and what we should speak to them about. The role focuses on building relationships, within Autodesk, with our Sales, Development and Engineering teams, but principally with our customers, taking ownership of their ideas, concerns and requests to build trust in our software. The intention is to have high value conversations, then collate and analyse those conversations into a coherent strategy for customer success.
 We value hybrid working, and if you live near enough to one of our offices you are welcome to work there some or all of the time, but remote working is also supported. You will report to the Manager for Customer Success, EMEA Water.
 Responsibilities
 You will establish and maintain working relationships with customers as a trusted technical advisor. You will collate and analyse customer conversations to identify what actions must be undertaken to improve the customer’s experience and promote the use of ICM. You will add value to the use of ICM. Scripting and the use of AI will be key components of this. You should seek to promote yourself as a subject expert through social media, webinars, conferences, and customer events. You will develop and deliver expert coaching to drive customer adoption, which could include: Model building and import from other model types. Calibration or verification against observed data. title: Principal Cloud Application Engineer
company: University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus
description:
Principal Cloud Application Engineer( Job Number:  40285)
 Description   Join Our Team and Make a Difference in Higher Education!
 At the System Administration office at the University of Colorado, we are dedicated to building a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Our office is committed to fostering a culture where employees find community, a sense of belonging, and the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to our mission and purpose.
 By joining our team, you’ll have a direct impact on shaping the future of higher education. In addition to the Office of the Board of Regents, the University of Colorado’s system administration includes 19 units that provide essential services to CU’s campuses in Aurora, Boulder, Colorado Springs, and Denver, as well as the Office of the President. While not a part of any one campus, we are proud to serve in the centralized office for the University system. Together, we ensure CU continues to deliver outstanding education, groundbreaking research, and valuable service to our communities.
 We believe in creating an environment where the unique experiences and perspectives of everyone are embraced, enriching the work we do and the strategic outcomes we pursue. If you’re passionate about making a difference, contributing to a dynamic team, and supporting a mission that matters, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey. Learn more about CU System Administration .

UIS is committed to excellence in customer service, technical expertise, and the development of enterprise applications responsible for supporting CU’s students, faculty, human resources employees, finance employees, and others.
